title: cancelability
rule: Provide a way to instantly cancel a time-consuming operation with no side effects.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Cancelability (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A time-consuming operation can be cancelled at once, with no side effects from the cancelled work.
fail_when: No cancel, cancel is not instant, or cancel still applies side effects.
overview: A time-consuming operation can be cancelled at once, with no side effects from the cancelled work.
not_when: Not for unclear Continue / Submit label.
agent_hint: Provide a way to instantly cancel a time-consuming operation with no side effects.
